changes.details: M4 request payload now includes accepted source claims, project research policy version, and a state digest that binds those values to advisory freshness. Intelligence history accepts an optional task type and applies it in PostgreSQL before the bounded row limit, preferring request_kind consistently with API projection.
The bounded history endpoint accepts an optional task_type filter and forwards it to the SQL history query.
History requests can specify task_type. Added typed evidenceContent method requested by packet B for its bounded source-content control.
Saved commercial assessment requests only M4 history from the server, so newer unrelated tasks cannot crowd it out.
Added a persisted-package regression for accepted claim, retraction, and conflict payload/freshness changes.
Added a 21-job regression showing server-side filtering returns the older assessment after 20 newer unrelated jobs, plus empty and unfiltered behavior.

validation.command: focused runner: ruff check on the two implementation and two test files

controls.generated_types: No OpenAPI response schema changed; controller owns shared generated type regeneration.

risks_and_limits: The filtered history query casts stored checkpoint text to PostgreSQL JSONB; it relies on persisted checkpoint values being valid JSON, as produced by the job writer.
The claim-state regression swaps current_research_state results through a focused test seam; it exercises payload and freshness behavior, not end-to-end source interpretation admission.
The evidence-content client method was added at packet B's request; its UI integration remains owned by packet B.
